summary.text: David LeBoeuf is a Democratic state representative from the 17th Worcester District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His legislative biography lists his profession as small business education advisor.

paragraphs.text: David LeBoeuf's legislative biography lists education at South High Community School, Clark University, Harvard College and the Harvard Kennedy School.
It also lists service on the Worcester Democratic City Committee from 2007 and on the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee from 2010 to 2014.
LeBoeuf took office on January 2, 2019, succeeding Republican Kate Campanale.

He serves on the House Committee on Steering, Policy and Scheduling and on the Joint Committees on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities, Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, and Housing.
